title: Airy Aerated Thai Chicken Tom Kha Soup
description: A one-pot Thai soup featuring yellow masarepa and shio-cure chicken, cooked to perfection with an airy aerated touch.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the lemongrass, galangal, and chili peppers, and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk, fish sauce, and lemon juice.
Add the sliced kaffir lime leaves and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the yellow masarepa and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until it has absorbed most of the liquid.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with additional kaffir lime leaves and lemongrass if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
